'''2010 Malastare Regionals Mike Samaniego DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Samaniego]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
